name: Turning Totems
review:
Totem poles on 11 lines with two-way wins, thunder reels, sleeping wilds, thunder snakes, respins and a bonus game.

There's a lot to watch in the base game for a low-volatility slot. And despite that low rating, the cap reaches 9,986x, which is rare. 96.1% RTP. A surprisingly lively game for players who usually avoid big-swing slots.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
